resources.string: Shows the Now Playing card on Home while music plays, and lets the remote\'s media keys control it while the card is up. Reads which app is in front, never screen content.
Now Playing needs notification access to see what is playing. Run addons/now-playing/install.sh from the CleanYourTV repo, or turn it on in Settings.
This TV has no notification access screen. Use install.sh.
Nothing is playing. Start music in Spotify or another app.
Card on Home while playing: Off
Card on Home while playing: On
The remote helper is off, so the card cannot show. Run install.sh again.
The remote\'s media keys control it
